parsed.rationale: Data are pinned (v1.3 database committed, tagged release images, scoring deterministic). Some components are not frozen: ICD-10-CM is downloaded live from CMS at first boot, SNOMED CT and LOINC are user-supplied, and the paper's Kimi and GLM runs used a private gateway that readers must replace.
